about: An example. Copy it to config/rolling-watch.json and make it yours: set class_year to the class you are in, write your own areas pattern, and add a company whenever a sweep or the Simplify list shows it posting new-grad reqs more than once a year. Each company is read from its own feed by scripts/rolling_watch.py; references/rolling-watch.md explains every field. Workday facet ids are copied from the careers URL's query string.

defaults.areas: machine learning|\bml\b|\bai\b|artificial intelligence|deep learning|inference|compiler|gpu|research|robot|autonom|perception|simulation|reinforcement|computer vision|data scien|applied scien|infrastructure|distributed|software

companies.name: NVIDIA
companies.why: Each team posts its own New College Grad req when it has headcount, February to September; the US new-college-grad facet holds them all.

companies.name: Google
companies.why: Custom career site, so it is read through the Simplify new-grad list.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.why: Posts continuously; new-grad routes appear as fellowship or residency reqs.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.why: Posts continuously across research and applied teams.

companies.name: Toyota Research Institute
companies.why: Opens resident reqs team by team, alongside occasional early-career research roles.
